generator.fraction_semantics: 40%/80% are mixture-component counts; background may also fall near boundary

executor: unchanged selector_engine.execute_task, one outer perf_counter_ns interval from before common geometry to after K normal results
uniform_warmup: one fresh K=100 task per dataset and execution, after prerecommendations and correctness, excluded from formal timing
gc: uniformly disabled during formal trials and restored afterwards
correctness: preflight and every completed task checked outside timer; error diagnostics saved and experiment stops
net_saving: control measured total minus strategy measured total; positive means faster
oracle: minimum of four fixed-method total-time MEDIANS for each scenario; not minimum raw trial
diagnosis: exact f and fixed-method performance generated only after recommendations locked; never fed back; labels may overlap and are not exclusive causal proof
same_method_two_four: if recommendations identical, small timing differences are not added-resolution benefits
no_trigger_statement: 本验证集未触发新增档位，未验证其被选中后的收益
